NASA OIG IG-23-010 Table 2 (hosted, PDF p21; r70_nasa_oig_2023_ig-23-010_table2_power_system_cost_mass.csv) prices the current solar systems of Lucy (500 mission W, 168 kg, $24M) and Europa Clipper (798 W, 525 kg, $72M): $48,000 and $90,226 per mission watt, $142,857 and $137,143 per kg (note: notional estimates; unit power is the average over design life). The code comment says "per installed Watt"; the code multiplies the delivered draw. This is the mass-without-a-price asymmetry the module's own comments hunt: the array's mass grows ~a^2 x 2.11 with distance and its cost does not.
